task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a Qiskit program that prepares the 3-qubit W state exactly (using controlled rotations) and verifies it by printing the statevector amplitudes of the basis states with a single 1. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
